reason: The 'no effect' result comes from an unjustified restriction to the north region (plus trimming). On the full sample of 2000 firms the supplier_diversity coefficient is 0.69 (SE 0.24, p=0.004) with the same controls, and 2.55 (p<0.001) with no controls. The north-only estimate (0.32, SE 0.35) is too imprecise to support a conclusion of no effect, and the report didn't disclose this sensitivity.
